Maya (CS): Heads-up — EBR Tue 11:00am PT. Need final slides + exec ask list by EOD Fri. Focus areas: onboarding health, renewal flags, enablement gaps, top feedback themes. I'll consolidate.

Samir (AE): Ack. I'll pull renewal signal + current NRR forecast. Any specific CRM exports you want?

Maya (CS): Yes @Samir — send ARR by cohort + last-touch CSAT. Put them in the same sheet on the shared Notion page: https://tinyurl.com/ebr-assets

Jordan (PM): @Maya can eng provide 1 slide on latency/cost improvements we've shipped? Product wants P50/P95 and unit-cost delta.

Eli (Solutions Eng): I can do the latency slide. Will include P50/P95 for gen endpoints and embeddings, plus note on caching/batching QoE. ETA: Friday 2pm. Metrics pulled from ops: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.internal/metrics/v1/latency?model=all`

Maya (CS): Perfect. Also need an enablement replay plan for the CSMs — 15min demo + 5min Qs. @Maude can you own the enablement comms?

Maude (CRO): I can own enablement. Will prep a 10-slide one-pager + a recording. Who will present the product demo live? @Eli or @Jordan?

Eli (Solutions Eng): Happy to present demo. I'll mock a 5-min scenario: onboarding flow -> SLA config -> failure fallback and rollback.

Samir (AE): Renewal risk note: account adoption sits at ~60% vs target. Exec flagged latency spikes last month. I'll attach support tickets and NPS snippets to the commercial slide.

Maya (CS): Action items before EOD Fri: 1) Slides by owners (Samir: commercial health; Eli: demo + telemetry; Jordan: roadmap/roadblocks; Maude: enablement assets) 2) Exec asks doc with one-line mitigation for each risk 3) Product feedback summary (top 3 themes + sample quotes).

cs-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for EBR Tue 11:00 PT — attendees: Maya, Samir, Jordan, Eli, Maude, Customer Execs.

Jordan (PM): For the survey summary I will extract themes from the last 6 weeks. Can someone drop the raw feedback export on the Notion page? @Samir

Samir (AE): Uploading the CSV to the Notion page now (done). File: onboarding_feedback_6w.csv

Maya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll stitch slides and run a dry-run Monday 9:00am PT. If anyone hits blockers, ping me direct. Thanks all!
